title: DNA review v1
description: One sample's review list (PROP-0004). Shapes shared with dna.notation/v1 and dna.consensus/v1 are referenced from those schemas by $id, so a validator needs all three registered.

error.description: Why the call failed; present exactly for call_failed.

calls.description: The sample's calls in the profile notation; for called under a profile that declares notation.

callable.description: The call's callable reference segments, merged, 1-based inclusive; for called.

reference_only.description: Reportable positions (1-based, increasing) the consensus decided as the reference by reference confirmations alone (ADR-0080); for called.

not_analysed.description: The stretches at the reportable regions' ends the call does not analyse, with their reason (SRS-CONS-012); a check item labelled not_analysed and a not_analysed zone hold each run of touching stretches; for called.

zones.description: The reportable positions as zones a reviewer opens whole, in reference order: each a maximal stretch, within one region, of one kind (and, for repeat, one profile window); for called.

rules.description: Version of the labelling rules, equal to the review plugin version.

signal.description: The run signal (dna.signal/v1) the second-channel thresholds were judged against, when one was given.

run_context.description: The run context (dna.run_context/v1) the two-strand rule's noise was calibrated by, when one was given (SRS-CONS-014, SRS-API-021).

masked.description: The read's masked stretches over the reportable regions, from the modality's callability segments (SRS-API-014): reference positions its aligned calls cover while its signal is dephased, mixed, weak, or irregularly spaced, so that it does not show its bases there.

unreliable.description: The read's unreliable stretches over the reportable regions (SRS-CALL-024): reference positions its aligned calls cover inside a span its modality asserts too poor for a difference it shows to stand unchecked, with the modality's reason.

mixtures.description: The read's phase mixtures (ADR-0082): stretches after a run whose signal the modality asserts is the read's own sequence superposed with copies offset by whole calls, each component compared with the reference on its own. Display only.

reference.description: The reference base; null for an inserted base.

alternate.description: The called base; null for a deleted base.

sequence.description: The decided sequence over the item: a site's call (N where undecided, empty when every position is deleted) or the reference base of a position outside every site; null when nothing was decided.

oneOf.description: Rules version 30 (ADR-0090): the site's supporting and opposing reads all lie on one strand. Lists the supporting, then the opposing reads.

explained.description: Present and true when every qualifying read of one strand shows a second peak the modality explains (not second_unexplained, SRS-CALL-022): the label is context, not a check (rules version 19).

share.description: The read's second peak share (SRS-CALL-015), above its threshold.

threshold.description: The share the second base had to exceed (SRS-CALL-020).

calls.description: The key's calls in the run signal, the sample's own taken out, when its run level was usable.

share.description: The share of the reference base's second peak (SRS-CALL-015) under the supporting read's other base, above its threshold; the difference rests on that read's strand alone.

threshold.description: The share the second base had to exceed (SRS-CALL-020).

calls.description: The key's calls in the run signal, the sample's own taken out, when its run level was usable.

reads.description: Every supporting read, all on `strand`, in the site's order.

oneOf.description: A decided deletion within review.deletion_zone positions of a reportable region's first or last position whose supporting reads all lie on one strand, however many (rules version 32): a check.

reads.description: Every supporting read, all on `strand`, in the site's order.

oneOf.description: A decided site at least review.run_growth bases shorter than its reference, which holds a run of at least review.phase_run equal bases, whose supporting reads all lie on one strand, however many (rules version 32): a check.

reads.description: Every supporting read, all on `strand`, in the site's order.

oneOf.description: A decided site outside every repeat window and length tract that changes a homopolymer run's length and whose supporting reads all lie on one strand, however many (rules version 32): a check.

A decided insertion outside every repeat window and length tract whose supporting reads all lie on one strand while no read of the other strand shows it (SRS-CONS-015): a check. `other` is the other strand's best view of the site; `from_start`, the fewest calls from a supporting read's first call to its first call over the site.

reasons.description: The reasons of the touching not_analysed stretches the item holds, each once, in reference order.

called.description: DNA's length; null when DNA reports none: its call holds an N, or a position of the window is not callable, so its decided length is an estimate.

convention.description: The length convention's reading (the [normalization] shortest-dominant policy, ISFG 2014 3.3.2): when every read's reading (its in-phase length, or the policy's reading of its decode) falls in one adjacent pair n, n + 1, n. A suggestion only, never DNA's call; null otherwise, without the policy, for a run whose structure differs, and in length_not_recorded.

floor.description: For a run DNA reports no length for (called null), the reads' floor reading: the least length any read gives as its top or next. A suggestion only, never DNA's call; null for a reported run and in length_not_recorded.

called.description: DNA's length; null when DNA reports none: its call holds an N, or a position of the window is not callable, so its decided length is an estimate.

convention.description: The length convention's reading (the [normalization] shortest-dominant policy, ISFG 2014 3.3.2): when every read's reading (its in-phase length, or the policy's reading of its decode) falls in one adjacent pair n, n + 1, n. A suggestion only, never DNA's call; null otherwise, without the policy, for a run whose structure differs, and in length_not_recorded.

floor.description: For a run DNA reports no length for (called null), the reads' floor reading: the least length any read gives as its top or next. A suggestion only, never DNA's call; null for a reported run and in length_not_recorded.

oneOf.description: Runs of a profile length tract (length_tracts) whose dominant length the reads determine, or that DNA does not report: a length heteroplasmy noted, context and never a check (SRS-API-020).

ignored_in_search.description: The window over which a database search (EMPOP) disregards the tract's length variants, 1-based inclusive.

called.description: DNA's reported length; null when DNA reports none.

status.description: confirmed (the reads confirm DNA's length), dominant (every read tops at it, the structure shown by a read in phase or decodes on both strands), convention (the reads hold a pair n, n + 1 the length convention reads as n, DNA's length one of them), or unconfirmed (DNA reports no length).

reading.description: The length a reviewer would record: DNA's, the convention's, or the floor reading when unconfirmed; null where the profile records no length or no read reaches the run.

agreement.description: How the reads' lengths agree, as length_unconfirmed gives it; null when no read reaches the run.

strands.description: Each strand's one clear length, when it gives one.

floor.description: The reads' floor reading, for a run DNA reports no length for.

convention.description: The length convention's reading (the [normalization] shortest-dominant policy, ISFG 2014 3.3.2): when every read's reading (its in-phase length, or the policy's reading of its decode) falls in one adjacent pair n, n + 1, n. A suggestion only, never DNA's call; null otherwise, without the policy, for a run whose structure differs, and in length_not_recorded.

first.description: The decode's first-run length distribution (signal shares, never heteroplasmy levels) and its margin z; null for a read in phase.

total.description: The decode's total length distribution; null for a read in phase.

side.description: A read on one side of a site's dissent: a supporting or an opposing read with its strand.

cause.description: Why the call shows a second peak, from its signal (SRS-CALL-021): the modality's cause, refined by the run signal to `context` when one is given; absent when the share does not reach signal_processing.second_floor.

labels.$comment: The label table, in the order DNA counts the labels: each label's rank (x-rank; an item's priority is its labels' lowest rank, 5 without a label) and whether it makes its item a check (x-check). An explained possible_heteroplasmy has rank 4 and is no check; a poor_signal label makes an item with a difference a check. DNA's label table (LabelKind) must agree.

zones.description: The zones, and those a check item touches.

kind.description: What the reads show there, in precedence order: a stretch the call does not analyse (rules version 36), a profile repeat window, no callable call, a read past a repeat out of phase, a read otherwise masked, every read in phase or vouched for.

name.description: The profile's repeat window name; exactly for repeat.

checks.description: The check items touching the zone.

explained.description: Whether the components explain the stretch at the read's own noise level (ADR-0082). Only then is each component compared with the reference; otherwise components carry offset and fraction alone.

components.description: Every component the modality asserts, the dominant sequence (offset 0) first; in an explained mixture a component placed on the reference also gives its interval, sequence, and calls.

unexplained.description: Reference positions (1-based, increasing) of the calls the components do not explain.

offset.description: Calls by which the sequence's run is longer (positive) or shorter (negative) than the dominant one's.

fraction.description: Its share of the fitted signal.

first.description: First reference position the component covers; after last when it crosses the origin.

sequence.description: Its bases over first..last on the reference strand.

calls.description: Its eligible edits in the profile notation, in reference order; empty under a profile without notation.
